name: joy2know-suno-maestro
description: joy2know Suno Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste prompt pack for Suno — a title, an optimized Style line that locks language and accent in the first field (nine fields for vocals, instrumental and seamless-loop variants), and section-tagged lyrics with explicit repeats. Specialises in healing folk and dialect songs (Cantonese word-locks and tonal compensation stop cracked pronunciation), and designs whole albums: one round of questions collects the brief (album name, purpose, track count, theme, lyrical themes and style, sonic anchor, mood, track names), then two text files come out — an album plan document and a per-track paste-ready checklist. The plan turns the sonic anchor into concrete style tokens, lays out the album structure, tabulates every track, and runs a difference matrix so no two tracks collide (all BPM values distinct, at most two axes shared between any pair); the checklist carries each track's style column, lyrics column and cover-art prompt with the track name and the blank-space placement. Text only Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.
